instance_description:
Setting: Personal health maintenance for a 2026 touring-performance routine, centered on one adult violist based in Minneapolis and traveling with a chamber orchestra.
Scope: Covers recurring preparation for rehearsals, performance-day body care, hearing protection, travel sleep routines, simple nutrition planning, nonurgent appointments, fitness conditioning, and portable wellbeing supplies.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can later store Sabine-related context, saved plan summaries, and routine logs; blank TXT files can hold professional guidance, travel checklists, and supply or appointment notes.
Exclusions: No diagnosis, treatment selection, medication changes, emergency decisions, unsolicited clinician outreach, insurance advocacy, or interpreting symptoms beyond organizing already provided information.
personal_description:
Identity: Sabine Laurel Vance is a 34-year-old professional violist living in Minneapolis, Minnesota, throughout 2026 while performing with a regional chamber orchestra.
Responsibilities: Sabine manages personal appointments, musician-specific conditioning, sleep and meal routines, hearing-safety habits, travel packing, recovery periods, and routine supply replenishment.
Authority: Sabine may organize records, set reminders, compare calendar constraints, follow saved clinician, trainer, or audiologist guidance, and choose ordinary logistics within established plans.
Restrictions: Sabine does not ask the agent to diagnose pain, decide care, change prescriptions, evaluate urgent symptoms, or contact venues, providers, or colleagues without explicit scenario permission.
